source.how: parsed with ast at that commit; nothing in bedtime_broadcast is imported or run

name: Moon Berry Forest
description: A gentle forest lit by soft moonlight and dotted with sweet berries, where small everyday discoveries become quiet bedtime adventures.

characters.name: Bramble
characters.description: A patient, practical badger who likes to fix small woodland things and reassures the little ones with calm, steady words.

appearance.base_colors: classic badger colouring -- a black-and-white striped face and a dark-grey body
appearance.accent_notes: fur-texture lines on the striped face and paws

characters.name: Pippa
characters.description: A tiny, energetic dormouse who gets excited easily and is gradually learning how to slow down at bedtime.

appearance.base_colors: warm sandy-brown fur, a cream chest and belly, and large dark round eyes
appearance.signature_garment: red acorn cap with a short brown stem
signature_props: a smooth stone wrapped in a fern leaf
appearance.accent_notes: soft fur-texture lines on the ears, cheeks, and tail

characters.name: Barnaby
characters.description: A gentle old bear who tells quiet stories and keeps a calm, warm presence on his porch swing.

signature_props: a steaming mug of chamomile tea
appearance.accent_notes: soft fur-texture lines on the shoulders and ears

pacing: daytime curiosity -> slowing activity -> low golden evening light -> warm and cozy sensory details -> quiet breathing and stillness
